evidence: The chemical composition of ultrathin films was analyzed by XWray photoelectron spectra (XPS, VG Multilab 2000). Surface morphology of freshly prepared samples was measured by a tapping mode atomic force microscopy (AFM, Agilent 5500) to avoid potential airWcontacted contamination. Transmission electron microscope (TEM, JEOLW2010FEF) was operated with a 200 kV acceleration voltage to study the film morphology as well as crystallinity. The film’s structure of thicker films was evaluated by Raman spectroscopy (LabRAM HR800) with 532 nm laser excitation. The film thickness was measured by spectroscopic ellipsometer (SE, J. A. Woollam Co. M2000). The catalytic activity toward oxidation of CO was tested in a homeWbuilt stainless reactor. A quadrupole mass spectrometers (QMS) was connected to the outlet to monitor the exhaust gas.
